name: Emmbi Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Emmbi Industries Ltd manufactures HDPE & PP - Woven Polymer based products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
EIL manufactures woven polymer-based products and flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBCs). Company’s Woven Sacks and Liners are used in containers, irrigation canals, man-made water bodies, flexible tanks, car covers, furniture covers, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.01 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.92% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.97% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 6.71% of profits over last 3 years
